exact_claim: On the RAR branch nu_RAR(y)=1/(1-exp(-sqrt(y))): (i) the deep expansion nu = 1/sqrt(y) + 1/2 + sqrt(y)/12 - y^(3/2)/720 + y^(5/2)/30240 + O(y^(7/2)) holds with exact rational coefficients Q = {1, 1/2, 1/12, 0, -1/720, 0, 1/30240, 0, -1/1209600, 0, 1/47900160,...} (Bernoulli family), radius of convergence |sqrt(y)| < 2 pi, i.e. y < 4 pi^2 = 39.4784176, and leading neglected term (after the y^(5/2) term) -y^(7/2)/1209600 absolute (-y^4/1209600 relative to the leading 1/sqrt(y)); (ii) the stable evaluation -1/expm1(-sqrt(y)) (= e^s/(e^s-1), certified) reproduces a 70-digit reference with max relative error 2.04e-16 over the 241-point grid y in [1e-16, 1e8] while the naive form 1/(1-exp(-sqrt(y))) fails a 1e-14 relative-accuracy bar at 105/241 points (max err 3.57e-9, catastrophic cancellation); (iii) 120-term series agrees to 1.04e-16 for y <= 10 and degrades toward the radius as predicted; (iv) on the MONO splice neighbourhood, landmarks re-derived (y* = 2.337412405, y_p = 2.539638282, h_p = 0.647610238; splice residual -4.3e-17) and nu_RAR != nu_mono on (y*, inf) with max |Delta nu| = 0.02475 at y ~ 13.7 on (y*, 1e4] and (g_mono - g_RAR)/a0 = 0.894 at y = 1e4, both branches sharing the Newtonian asymptote nu -> 1 with different approach rates (e^{-sqrt y} vs O(log y / y)): matching one asymptote does not identify the branch (criterion B, RAR conclusions only; MONO comparison only). Domain: y = B/a0 in (0, 4 pi^2) for the series; y in (0, 1e8] for the stable evaluation; both a0 footings via the dimensional map g = a0*y*nu.
